plan.notes: Transcribed from the official ARC 'Spanish AA-T Degree - heritage/advanced (Full Time, ZTC)' program roadmap, Catalog 2026-27, published July 17, 2026 (mapmaker.losrios.edu/Maps/7348/PublishedPdf), GE Pattern: Cal-GETC. Total Units 60 = 16+16+14+14 (semester sums verified). tccns mirrors ARC local course codes (California community colleges do not use TCCNS). This map is designed for Spanish heritage speakers and advanced Spanish speakers. SPAN 411 prerequisite: SPAN 402 or three years of high school Spanish; students not meeting the SPAN 411 prerequisite through coursework must take a prerequisite challenge exam prior to enrolling in SPAN 411. ZTC (Zero Textbook Cost): with the proper selection of courses, this program can be completed without paying for any textbooks — look for the ZTC symbol in the class schedule. Many universities require students to take their entire Spanish series at the same institution; see a counselor for more information. The Area 5C (Science Lab) course must correspond with either the Area 5A or Area 5B course and must be taken concurrently or after the lecture course. Transferable elective courses: any elective courses numbered 300-499, or having a 4-digit number starting with C. Students can substitute ESLW 340 for ENGL C1000/C1000H. The CSU system requires every bachelor's degree student to be knowledgeable about the U.S. Constitution, American history, and state and local government (American Institutions); students can complete this requirement at ARC before transferring. See ASSIST.ORG for transfer requirements of the destination institution.
